arguments.where_clause: amount_usd_cents > 100000 AND card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type IN ('Debit', 'Debit (Prepaid)'))
arguments.explanation: Flags transactions over $1,000 made on debit cards, including prepaid debit cards.
assumptions: Counted prepaid debit cards ('Debit (Prepaid)') as debit cards along with 'Debit'.
Took 'over $1,000' to mean strictly more than $1,000.00, so a transaction of exactly $1,000.00 is not flagged.
Negative amounts are never flagged, because they cannot be over $1,000.
